# 程轶婧律师 Yijing Cheng — 上海律师 / PRC lawyer in Shanghai

> 程轶婧，上海市君悦律师事务所（MHP Law Firm）律师，中国律师执业资格，2023年12月起从事法律工作。办理公司股权与股东纠纷（股东知情权、股东代表诉讼、股东资格确认与股权代持显名、法定代表人涤除登记、公司解散）、劳动争议与用工合规、合同与担保纠纷，并可用英文办理涉外投资、合同与争议事务。
> Yijing Cheng is a PRC-licensed lawyer at MHP Law Firm in Shanghai who works in English and Chinese with foreign companies and investors on shareholder disputes (including in joint ventures), employment matters, commercial contract disputes and cross-border transactions in China. LL.M., Vanderbilt University Law School; LL.B., Shanghai University of Finance and Economics.

## Practice areas

- 公司股权与股东纠纷 / Corporate and shareholder disputes: shareholder information rights (accounting books and vouchers), derivative actions, shareholder status and nominee shareholding, removal of legal-representative registration, company dissolution and liquidation, shareholder disputes in foreign-invested companies, financing-round terms and articles of association
- 劳动争议与用工合规 / Employment: termination, severance and damages, non-compete and confidentiality, employee handbooks, labor dispatch and outsourcing, work-injury claims
- 合同与担保纠纷 / Commercial contract and guarantee disputes
- 涉外 / Cross-border: foreign direct investment, cross-border equity investment and M&A (bilingual Chinese–English agreements), international trade disputes, international arbitration

## Representative matters (anonymized)

- Court ruling removing a departed executive from a company's legal-representative registration
- Court accepted a shareholder's claim that inspection rights extend to accounting vouchers
- Judicial dissolution action for a minority shareholder in a deadlocked company
- China–Italy investment and acquisition: review and reconciliation of bilingual Chinese–English investment agreements
- International trade contract dispute involving a Middle East counterparty (led)
- Formation of a frontier-technology company in North America
- Multiple financing rounds of a technology company (identified and proposed fixes for conflicting terms); bankruptcy liquidation with a share-swap scheme; guarantor liability limited to the agreed scope
